title: Unveiling Cultural Blind Spots: Analyzing the Limitations of mLLMs in Procedural Text Comprehension

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on culturally specific procedural texts (such as rituals, craftsmanship, and social etiquette) from seven distinct countries using tasks like step reordering, multiple-choice questions, and conversation-based reasoning.

Comparing model comprehension and reasoning capabilities on the same procedural texts when prompted in a high-resource language (English) versus seven native, varying-resource languages (e.g., Hausa, Urdu, Indonesian) to measure disparities in cross-lingual capabilities.
